fixes.detail: ice_formation has no light at all in placements_resolved (no 'light' key), so the 'only cold light on B1' is a dark brown slab. Add blue emission (translucent emissive ice, ~1000-1500 W area at 9000-10000 K behind it) and the icicle curtain over the door. Slim it to d 0.4 and push it dy +0.2 onto the wall so it doesn't stand 1 m into the water at the door; seat it at -20.0 rather than -20.2.

Six 0.8x0.3x1.2 boxes stand at z -20.2, evenly spaced on both kerbs, and read as grey bollards in the water. Snap them to the walls at z -19.3 to -17.8 with d 0.1, varying w [0.4,1.4], denser toward the door (spacing [0.5,2.5]), and add 4-6 icicle proxies hanging from the ceiling in the last 6 m.

The treatment-door pair (144.4,84.3)/(147.6,84.15) half-overhangs the water (pool edge ~84.3), so move them dy -0.25. Replace them with low 0.6 m andon at 10-15 W; right now they are the brightest objects in the entry and concept views, ahead of the hero.
